notes: Verifier I, wave 4 (batch I, I11). Printed: 'Activate only if you control a creature with flying' is a restriction on ACTIVATING (CR 602.5b), not an intervening if: it is judged when the ability is activated, not again on resolution. The ability is activated with your flier out and held on the stack; the flier leaves in response; the ability still resolves and taps the target.
